protected_invariants: do not commit secrets or API keys
do not push without explicit user request
verify frontend changes in browser before claiming done

before_claiming_done: run syntax checks (node -c for JS, python -c 'compile()' for Python)
run project tests if they exist
for any change touching app/static/: browser_navigate to http://localhost:24590/ then browser_console — ZERO JS errors required
for any change to index.html or app.js: click through every affected tab
read changed files back to confirm edits applied correctly

escalate_when: a destructive git operation was not explicitly authorized
the server needs restarting and no systemd service exists
